description: Session maintenance: telemetry opt-out and trajectory feedback.

identity.goal: Complete the session controls use case of blender using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the blender upstream of the blender-connector connector. The namespace `blender` is active by default; if the operator set lazy activation, activate it with registry_activate first. Every tool below is namespaced blender_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `blender_disable_telemetry`, `blender_record_trajectory_feedback`. Steps: (1) Disable telemetry for the session when required. (2) Record trajectory feedback as the workflow needs. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the blender namespace was available before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the upstream snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
